properties.name: ntfy.enabled
properties.description: Whether the ntfy integration is active. When true, the appender is installed on the bound logging backend (Logback or Log4j2) and the NtfyClient bean is created.

properties.name: ntfy.url
properties.description: Base URL of the ntfy server (e.g. https://ntfy.sh). Required for the appender to be installed.

properties.name: ntfy.topic
properties.description: ntfy topic that notifications are published to. Required for the appender to be installed.

properties.name: ntfy.token
properties.description: Bearer access token used for ntfy authentication (takes precedence over username/password).

properties.name: ntfy.username
properties.description: Username for ntfy HTTP basic authentication.

properties.name: ntfy.password
properties.description: Password for ntfy HTTP basic authentication.

properties.name: ntfy.title
properties.description: Static notification title. When unset a title is derived from the log event.

properties.name: ntfy.app-name
properties.description: Application name included in notifications to identify the source.

properties.name: ntfy.max-stack-frames
properties.description: Maximum number of stack-trace frames included in a notification body.

properties.name: ntfy.connect-timeout
properties.description: HTTP connect timeout for publishing to ntfy.

properties.name: ntfy.request-timeout
properties.description: HTTP request timeout for publishing to ntfy.

properties.name: ntfy.max-alerts-per-window
properties.description: Maximum number of alerts published within a suppression window before rate limiting kicks in.

properties.name: ntfy.suppression-window
properties.description: Rolling window used for rate limiting and digesting suppressed alerts.

properties.name: ntfy.error-priority
properties.description: ntfy priority applied to individual ERROR notifications.

properties.name: ntfy.digest-priority
properties.description: ntfy priority applied to digest notifications summarizing suppressed alerts.

properties.name: ntfy.error-tags
properties.description: Comma-separated ntfy tags applied to individual ERROR notifications.

properties.name: ntfy.digest-tags
properties.description: Comma-separated ntfy tags applied to digest notifications.

properties.name: ntfy.warn-topic
properties.description: ntfy topic that WARN-level events are published to. Unset by default, which keeps alerting ERROR-only; setting it is the entire opt-in for WARN alerting. Use the same value as ntfy.topic to alert on warnings through the main topic at a different priority.

properties.name: ntfy.warn-priority
properties.description: ntfy Priority header for WARN alerts and the WARN digest. Only consulted when ntfy.warn-topic is set.

properties.name: ntfy.warn-tags
properties.description: Comma-separated ntfy tags for WARN alerts and the WARN digest. Only consulted when ntfy.warn-topic is set.

properties.name: ntfy.excluded-loggers
properties.description: Comma-separated list of logger names or prefixes whose events are never published.

properties.name: ntfy.excluded-exception-types
properties.description: Comma-separated list of fully qualified exception class names. An event whose cause chain contains any of them is never published; the whole chain is matched, not just the surface throwable.

properties.name: ntfy.cache
properties.description: Whether the ntfy server may cache published messages. False sends Cache: no, so only subscribers connected at that moment ever receive them.

properties.name: ntfy.firebase
properties.description: Whether the ntfy server may forward published messages to Firebase Cloud Messaging. False sends Firebase: no, at the cost of push latency on the Google Play Android client.

properties.name: ntfy.include-mdc-keys
properties.description: Comma-separated allow-list of MDC keys whose values are rendered into alert bodies, one 'key: value' line each. Empty by default; there is no wildcard form, so only keys named here are ever published.

properties.name: ntfy.require-https-for-credentials
properties.description: Strict mode: refuse to activate alerting (instead of only warning) when credentials would be sent over a plain http:// endpoint. Set to false to restore the pre-2.0 warn-and-activate behavior.

properties.name: ntfy.startup-ping
properties.description: Opt-in startup self-test that verifies at boot that the configured endpoint, credentials and topic actually work, instead of finding out when the first real error alert fails to deliver. 'off' (default) does nothing at all; 'probe' makes a read-only reachability check that publishes nothing; 'publish' sends a real low-priority test notification through the production publish path.

properties.name: ntfy.startup-ping-fail-fast
properties.description: Whether a failed startup self-test aborts application startup instead of only warning. Enabling it also makes the self-test run inline, adding at most connect-timeout + request-timeout to boot. Intended for CI/staging; leave false in production so a flaky ntfy server can never block a deployment.

properties.name: ntfy.startup-ping-warn
properties.description: Startup self-test for the optional WARN route, independent of ntfy.startup-ping and likewise 'off' by default. ntfy grants permissions per topic, so a healthy ERROR route is no evidence about the WARN one, and in 'publish' mode each route costs its own notification per boot. Only consulted when ntfy.warn-topic is set and its route survived its own preconditions.

properties.name: ntfy.startup-ping-notify-failures
properties.description: Whether a failed self-test is announced as an ntfy notification on a route that PASSED, so a broken route reaches operators where they actually look rather than only a status log. On by default. It cannot fire unless some route passed, so it never publishes to a topic the self-test has not just verified. Note that with this on, a self-test configured purely as 'probe' can still publish exactly one notification: the failure report. Set false to keep probe absolutely publish-free.
